name: browser-use
headline: AI Overmind: Enhance Claude with Agent Skills
short_description: A public repository of agent skills that extend Claude's capabilities with specialized task templates for creative, technical, enterprise, and productivity workflows.
author: SpaceFrontiers

sections.overview:
ai-overmind is a public repository of Agent Skills—reusable instruction sets that teach Claude how to complete specialized tasks repeatedly and reliably. Each skill is self-contained with instructions, scripts, and resources organized by category: creative and design, development and technical, enterprise and communication, and personal productivity. Skills use progressive disclosure to load detailed instructions only when needed, keeping context windows efficient. The repository includes a skill template, quickstart guide, and development guide to help users create and deploy custom skills to Claude via Claude.ai, Claude Code, or the API. Teams use these skills to encode company workflows, branding guidelines, testing procedures, and automation patterns into Claude's behavior.
Create branded documents with company style guidelines embedded in Claude
Automate system administration and testing tasks with custom scripts
Standardize enterprise communications and workflows
Build repeatable personal productivity workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/SpaceFrontiers/ai-overmind`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an AI Overmind to manage multiple AI agents. Assign tasks to agents based on their strengths, monitor progress, and ensure coordination. Use the following agents: [AGENT1], [AGENT2], [AGENT3]. The goal is to [GOAL]. Provide a status update every [TIME_INTERVAL] hours.
```
Copy

requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
